header: An icon, a title and one sentence
lead: The standard feature grid, in two to four columns. The card style gives each cell a surface, the plain style removes it.

items.title: Two to four columns
items.text: Editors choose the number of columns. The grid adapts to the space it has, not to the screen width.

items.title: Card or plain
items.text: The style adds or removes the card surface. Spacing, order and icons stay the same.

items.title: Cells of equal height
items.text: Each cell stretches to the tallest cell in its row, so the icons line up.

items.title: One link per cell
items.text: Give a cell a link and the whole cell becomes clickable. The title names the link for screen readers.
